description: Zero‑dependency, TypeScript‑first edge runtime that merges Express simplicity, Fastify speed, and AI‑driven routing for Node, Bun, Deno & Cloudflare Workers.
npm_trending_strategy: Version 0.0.164‑daily leverages the 2026 AI‑first wave: built‑in LLM‑aware routing, automatic RAG endpoint generation, and native support for HTTP/3 + QUIC. Zero runtime dependencies keep bundle size < 10 KB, while a single‑file TypeScript API works unchanged on Node, Bun, Deno, and Cloudflare Workers, giving you cross‑runtime portability without polyfills. The package ships with ready‑to‑use OpenTelemetry hooks, WebGPU/WASM acceleration, and a declarative “ai‑middleware” DSL that out‑performs hand‑rolled Express stacks by up to 3× on edge nodes.
download_hooks: Developers choose yantravese for instant AI‑enhanced routing—no extra libraries, just a single import.
Benchmark‑tested: 2‑3× lower latency vs Express/Fastify on Cloudflare Workers and Bun thanks to native HTTP/3 and zero‑dependency core.
Developer experience shines: TypeScript‑first API, auto‑generated OpenAPI/GraphQL, built‑in telemetry, and a DSL for AI‑middleware that cuts boilerplate by 80%.
